test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The sky is covering / with dark clouds and / I hope soon it / will begin to rain.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. The sky is covering .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is incorrect because of the phrase **"is covering"**.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"is covered"** to indicate the passive voice, suggesting that the sky is being affected by the action of being covered by clouds.

Correct sentence: *The sky **is covered** with dark clouds and I hope soon it will begin to rain*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Passive Voice:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + is/am/are + past participle
 
• **Example:** The book is read by many people.
 
• **Usage: **Describes an action done to the subject by someone or something else.
